info.title: The Cedar Table — Smart Queue API
info.description: Restaurant queue, arrival, table allocation and dining API. All commands use server sessions and CSRF. Domain commands additionally require Idempotency-Key. Read projections and estimates are advisory; PostgreSQL transactions enforce authoritative state.

session.name: SESSION
session.description: Spring Session JDBC cookie. HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax; secure outside local demo profile.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique command key per actor/route. Reuse exactly the same key and body to replay a command; changed body with the same key returns 409.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-TOKEN
CsrfToken.description: Obtain token/headerName from GET /auth/csrf. Fetch a fresh token after login. Send session cookies.

password.description: Maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes. Passwords are hashed with BCrypt.

PolicyInput.description: minimumSamples must not exceed sampleSize. Session policy updates are audited.

timezone.description: Valid IANA timezone, for example Asia/Kolkata.

preference.description: ANY or a configured dining-area name. Soft preference.

challenge.description: Short-lived venue challenge; never log or persist its plaintext.
